mission: Descent through Levels 1 and 2 — Operations and Archive. The fortress tells its own story through the equipment Gavran left running and the records he ordered. A monitoring panel still tracks a network of nodes, most dark, one flashing BREACH.
why_now: Sequential exploration — each level deepens the scope of the emergency. Let the building reveal what it is for.
conflict: The archive is meticulously organized where time allowed and frantically stacked where it did not. Ben can read fragments but has no vocabulary for what the fragments imply. Force-locks refuse the deeper material to a modern signature.
turning_point: A monitoring display still functions — a network of nodes spread across the Outer Rim, most reading dead, three reading active, one reading BREACH. The network is a containment system, and it is losing.
opening_hook: Level 1 is a command post. The communications equipment died centuries ago but the monitoring stations retain residual power — and they're tracking something.
closing_hook: The stairwell to Level 3 descends into blue-tinged emergency lighting. The Force down there is different — not wrong but alive, pulsing with three distinct rhythms. People. Living people, sealed below.
emotional_trajectory: Archaeological wonder -> growing dread -> shock at the living Force signatures

stakes.personal: Ben is descending into something he does not understand
stakes.interpersonal: Desh catalogues exits and escape routes — his instincts say this is wrong
stakes.external: The monitoring system reveals a network in cascading failure

setting: Fortress interior — Level 1 (Operations) through Level 2 (Archive), descending corridor to Level 3
sensory_details: Residual power humming in the walls; dust on surfaces undisturbed for centuries; archive media — holocrons, data tablets, vacuum-sealed documents; the air growing warmer and more charged the lower they go, the fortress breathing again after a millennium
canon_elements_needed: Jedi holocron and archive storage technology
Living Force signatures detection and differentiation
action_beats: Ben activates residual power on the monitoring stations with a targeted Force pulse
A display screen flickers alive showing the containment network map — nodes in red, amber, and one flashing BREACH
Desh photographs every console and catalogues exit routes on his datapad
Ben descends the stairwell toward Level 3, the blue-tinged emergency lighting intensifying below
notes: Gavran's voice should be felt through what he chose to keep and how he organised it — meticulous where time allowed, frantic where it did not. The monitoring display is the bridge to Level 3. Diagnostic-voice trap — Ben should not, in this scene, reconstruct what the network is for; he registers the red, the amber, the one flashing BREACH, and moves. The three living rhythms in the closing hook should be perceived, not interpreted: 'one disciplined, one heavy, one clipped' is the level of detail Ben can carry here. Names and histories wait for Ch5.

turning_point_detail.trigger: A monitoring display flickers alive, showing a network map with nodes in red, amber, and one flashing BREACH across the Outer Rim.
turning_point_detail.shift: The abstract threat becomes concrete and systemic: the fortress is not a tomb but a control center for a failing containment infrastructure. The emergency is not local.
turning_point_detail.cost: Ben commits to descent without full knowledge of what he's descending into. Desh's cataloguing of exits signals his instinct that this is wrong—the cost splits between Ben's ignorance and Desh's growing unease about the mission's true scope.

emotional_arc.start: Archaeological wonder—the thrill of discovery in an ancient, preserved space
emotional_arc.shift: Growing dread as the monitoring display transforms abstract threat into concrete system failure
emotional_arc.end: Shock at the living Force signatures—the realization that the fortress contains not artifacts but prisoners

key_beats.beat_description: Ben activates residual power on the monitoring stations with a targeted Force pulse; the equipment hums to life after centuries of dormancy.
key_beats.state_change: The Operations level transforms from a dead archive into a functional command post. Residual systems respond to Force contact, confirming the fortress was built by Force-users and designed to remain partially active.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Archaeological wonder—the satisfaction of making something ancient respond, of reading the room's design through its reaction. Ben's instinct pushes toward action (activating, exploring) rather than analysis; he is reading the space kinetically, not intellectually.

key_beats.beat_description: A display screen flickers alive showing a network map: nodes scattered across the Outer Rim in red (dead), amber (degraded), and one flashing BREACH in urgent white.
key_beats.state_change: The pressure shifts from 'what is this place' to 'what is failing.' The fortress reveals itself as a hub in a larger system. The BREACH node transforms the scene from exploration into emergency response.
key_beats.pov_reaction: The wonder collapses into dread. Ben's focus narrows—his eyes track the flashing node, his breath catches slightly. The Force around the display feels wrong in a new way: not deadened but *strained*, as if the system itself is screaming. His body tightens; his next move is toward the display, not away.

key_beats.beat_description: Desh photographs every console and catalogues exit routes on his datapad, his movements precise but his jaw tight. He does not ask what the network is for; he is already calculating how to get out.
key_beats.state_change: The scene pivots from Ben's solo discovery to a two-person dynamic. Desh's practical response—exits, escape vectors—introduces a counterpoint to Ben's forward momentum. His unease becomes a second pressure in the room.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben registers Desh's shift in posture and tone. It lands as a warning Ben does not yet have the vocabulary to name. The dread deepens because Desh's fear is contagious; Ben's confidence in 'we can handle this' wavers slightly. He does not slow down, but he notices that Desh wants to.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben moves toward the stairwell descending to Level 3. The blue-tinged emergency lighting intensifies below, casting the stairs in an otherworldly glow. The air grows warmer, more charged.
key_beats.state_change: The boundary between known and unknown sharpens. Level 3 is no longer abstract—it is below, it is lit, it is calling. The fortress's architecture itself pulls Ben downward.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Shock. The Force down there is alive in a way the upper levels are not. Ben perceives three distinct rhythms—one disciplined, one heavy, one clipped—without naming them. The shock is not fear but recognition: something is waiting. Something has been waiting. His hand moves to the railing; his descent begins.
